turns.text: Bogodimo bja ngwedi bo dirilwe ka maswika le lerole. Le manonala a ka ntle-ntle la ngwedi le bitšwa legogo.
turns.en: The surface of the moon is made of rocks and dust. And the outermost layer of the moon is called the crust.
